scope: Average weekly hours for all employees on private nonfarm payrolls in 36 dated BLS Employment Situation releases
limits: Zero changes from unchanged/remained/held/for nth month wording are marked as stability-word interpretations; numeric nonzero changes are explicitly printed.
The previous month's hours level can be revised in a later release, so do not compute a current change across releases.
Original web publication/receipt times and bytes remain unauthenticated.
